title: Alpaca camera mapping writes past its fixed property capacity
description:
Category security; severity medium; confidence high. Owner coordinator; open, nonblocking audit follow-up. Location: indigo_drivers/agent_alpaca/indigo_agent_alpaca.c:1210-1217. Camera Bayer property is allocated for ALPACA_MAX_ITEMS128 at:1000. When all slots are occupied, cam_number equals count128 and the code still forms items+128, writes label/name and increments count. The earlier main device mapping check at:1186 rejects more than128 devices but does not leave the enclosing CCD branch, so it does not guard this independent array. Distinct camera names can also accumulate through discovery/session churn. This causes out-of-bounds heap writes and subsequent over-count property publication. Unlike existing FND-...-035 (core native registry >= bug), this is a separate Alpaca property mapping contract. Reject/omit a new Bayer entry at capacity before forming the item pointer; preserve existing camera mappings and ensure an unmapped camera has no invalid Bayer pointer. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (FM-3). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261024121920-3bd2-repository-audit-031.json (category: security, blocking: no).
